newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted in bids and offers steady to higher on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus eight barges traded on southbound barge freight options on Wednesday, exchange sources said. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, this week, St Paul-Savage (Upper Mississippi River) no bid, offered at 255 percent of tariff, unchanged from previous offer.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 225 percent of tariff, up 15 percentage points, offer 235 percent, up 20 percentage points.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, no bid, offer 210 percent, unchanged.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, no bid, offer 185 percent, up five percentage points.
- Four barges, one each week November, Lower Ohio River, no bid, offer 180 percent.
- Four barges, two each weeks December 1 and 8, Illinois River, bid 152-1/2 percent, offer 160 percent.
